text: Implemented CategoricalObservationSource and NearestCentroidClassification as ordinary ScientificSource/Estimand values with Compile and MeasurementTask instances. Mvpa.run now executes the same typed program across region, global, mixed local-failure, and searchlight frames. Dense/matrix-free parity is exact; boundary receipts distinguish source and measured representation and record explicit local materialization. SpatialResultScatter consumes only SearchlightRendition and restores compact-center order. Full mvpa JVM/JS 239/239 and mvpa-spatial JVM/JS 11/11 pass; legacy freeze and diff check pass.
